# Branding and Naming

## Overview
This wiki page covers the branding and naming guidelines, preliminary trademark clearance results, and co-[marketing](./marketing.md) rules for products and technologies associated with [Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) and [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md).

## Key Details
* **[MeshSync](./meshsync.md)**: Cleared with a caveat regarding similar mesh [IoT](./iot.md) marks.
* **TeaBuddy**: Cleared in class 21 for kitchen gadgets.
* **"[Puck](./teabuddy.md)"**: The term alone is crowded; use "[TeaBuddy Puck](./teabuddy.md)" together.
* **"SteepSync"**: Rejected internally by Alex.
* **"[Nova](./aurora-nova-widget-v2.md)"**: Using "Nova" alone conflicts with an existing tech mark; use **[Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md)** instead.
* **Co-marketing**: Permitted as long as logos are separated by a minimum of 24px.
